correctness.rationale: For each color class with t edges of \(K_6\), six endpoint degrees sum to \(2t\), so discrete convexity yields the exact integer lower bound \(B(t)\). Minimizing \(B(s)+B(t)+B(15-s-t)\) over \(t\) yields all sixteen displayed sector energies; the sixteen ternary witnesses independently attain these lower bounds. The six hull points (0,24),(3,12),(6,12),(9,18),(12,36),(15,60) have consecutive slopes -4,0,2,6,8, with all intervening occupancy points collinear, which rigorously forces the five and only five coexistence fields. Three compiled exhaustive implementations enumerated all 14,348,907 assignments; degree-based ternary counts, subset-mask counts, and explicit 60-bond counts agree on every fixed-s minimum and multiplicity, including each critical-field sum. No partial census or numerical extrapolation is invoked.

value.rationale: The triangular graph \(L(K_6)\) is a natural highly symmetric, fifteen-site, strongly regular frustrated spin cluster, with three spin colors fewer than its edge chromatic index five. All sixteen occupancy sectors meet a simultaneous sharp degree-convexity bound with a converse classification of every fixed-occupancy minimizer, and its magnetic response exhibits five distinct thresholds at which four sectors coexist. Exact labeled degeneracies and witnesses make this a complete physically interpretable zero-temperature benchmark rather than a routine or arbitrary single number; no thermodynamic-scale assertion is made.
